caption:
Carrot Cake Overnight Oats
lazy girl breakfast series | meal prep friendly | high protein 

Nutrition: 
C: 50 | F: 16 | P: 29
Calories: 450 per serve 
Serves 1

Ingredients
30 grams oats 
1 tbsp chia seed
1 cup milk
1 tsp honey / monkfruit
1 tbsp greek yogurt
1 tbsp raisins
1/2 tsp cinnamon powder
1/4 tsp nutmeg powder
few drops of vanilla extract
1/2 carrot, shredded
1/2 scoop, unflavoured whey or vanilla protein powder  1 tbsp granola for crunch, optional 

Method 
combine all the ingredients together in a container and leave them in the fridge overnight 
the next morning, add to a bowl and top with some more shredded carrots, a pinch of cinnamon and some granola for crunch if you want :) 

tips: 
skip the protein if you want or add in a full scoop to increase protein by 13 grams ish

note: 
this isnt a carrot cake recipe but it does have the same elements that a traditional carrot cake base has! and is meant to be a fun addition to your breakfast once in a while :)
